legislation.citation: Safeguarding Vulnerable Groups Act 2006 (amended PoFA 2012); gov.uk DBS guidance
legislation.failure_mode: Barred person employed; RAP fails in duty to refer; CQC questions fitness
legislation.law: Regulated activity with adults + DBS barred-list checks
requires: Enhanced DBS + Adults' Barred List for personal care, healthcare under direction/supervision, social work, day-to-day management of those doing it
Regulated Activity Providers have a legal duty to refer

legislation.citation: Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014 (SI 2014/2936), Regs 9-20A
legislation.failure_mode: Refused registration; enforcement; rating drop kills referrals
legislation.law: CQC fundamental standards + fit and proper persons
requires: Reg 19: robust recruitment, relevant checks, ongoing fitness monitoring
Regs 9-20A: person-centred care, consent, safe care, safeguarding, staffing, governance, duty of candour

legislation.citation: SVGA 2006 Sch 4 Pt 1 (same Act as verified adult regime; exact wording to confirm)
legislation.failure_mode: Unsafeguarded contact with minors; business-ending incident
legislation.law: Regulated activity with children (teaching/training unsupervised)
legislation.notes: Directionally certain, citation to confirm against DBS eligibility guidance
requires: Enhanced DBS + Children's Barred List for unsupervised teaching/training of under-18s

legislation.citation: Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998, reg 3; HSE ACOP L56
legislation.failure_mode: Criminal offence; invalidates insurance; employer liable
legislation.law: Gas competence + Gas Safe Register membership
requires: No gas work unless competent; no employee/self-employed gas work unless in HSE-approved class (Gas Safe Register)
Employers must ensure + monitor competence

legislation.citation: Reg 2015/2067 (retained UK law); Fluorinated Greenhouse Gases Regulations 2015
legislation.failure_mode: Criminal offence; failed F-Gas audit; fines
legislation.law: F-Gas qualification requirement
requires: Certificate required to install/service/maintain/leak-check/recover/decommission refrigeration, AC and heat-pump equipment containing F-gases

legislation.citation: Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015 (SI 2015/51), regs 12-15
legislation.failure_mode: Site shut down; directors liable; locked out of tenders
legislation.law: CDM principal-contractor + contractor duties
requires: Principal contractor: plan/manage/monitor, construction phase plan, coordinate H&S
Contractors: SKET-check every appointee (reg 15(7)); domestic-client duties default to contractor in control

legislation.citation: Finance Act 2004 ss58-59; HMRC CISR manuals
legislation.failure_mode: CIS penalties; cash-flow shock from wrong deductions
legislation.law: Construction Industry Scheme deductions
requires: Verify subbies with HMRC; deduct 20%/30%; broad scope catches labour-only and arranged works

legislation.citation: Food Information (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2019 (SI 2019/1218), in force 1 Oct 2021
legislation.failure_mode: Allergic reaction without label trail; prosecution
legislation.law: Natasha's Law: PPDS allergen labelling
requires: Name + full ingredients with 14 allergens emphasised, on package/label, for prepacked-for-direct-sale food

legislation.citation: Employment (Allocation of Tips) Act 2023, in force 1 Oct 2024; ITEPA Reg 100; gov.uk tronc guidance
legislation.failure_mode: Unlawful deductions + NIC errors; tribunal exposure
legislation.law: Fair tips: 100% pass-through + written policy + tronc rules
requires: Allocate 100% of qualifying tips fairly, no deductions; written policy where non-occasional; independent tronc = NIC-efficient only if genuinely independent

legislation.citation: Finance (No.2) Act 2017; Income Tax (Digital Requirements) Regulations 2021; Deloitte TaxScape Mar 2026
legislation.failure_mode: HMRC penalties (points-based, £200); client churn at mandate dates
legislation.law: MTD for Income Tax: digital records + quarterly updates
requires: Apr 2026: £50k+; Apr 2027: £30k+; Apr 2028: £20k+; compatible software; points accrue per missed deadline

legislation.citation: Money Laundering Regulations 2017; gov.uk accountancy-supervision guidance
legislation.failure_mode: Unsupervised practice = criminal offence; firm shutdown
legislation.law: AML supervision for accountancy service providers (incl. bookkeepers)
requires: Register with HMRC or professional-body supervisor (ICB/AAT/ACCA etc.) unless exempt (<£30k turnover + <5% accountancy + supervised review)

legislation.citation: CMA Funerals Market Investigation Order 2021 (Enterprise Act 2002)
legislation.failure_mode: CMA enforcement; reputational damage in a trust market
legislation.law: Funeral price transparency + inducement ban (NO licensing regime yet)
requires: Standardised Price List + Attended/Unattended Funeral Prices; ownership disclosure; BAN on hospital/hospice/care-home inducements and coroner/police solicitation; price/volume reporting
NOTE: inspection/registration regime only RECOMMENDED, not in force in England/Wales

legislation.citation: Town and Country Planning Act 1990; TPO Regulations 2012; s.211 conservation-area notices
legislation.failure_mode: Illegal fell: prosecution, unlimited fine, replanting orders
legislation.law: Tree Preservation Orders + conservation-area controls
legislation.notes: Response windows vary by route (conservation-area notice 6 weeks; TPO applications typically 8) — track per-application, never hardcode one clock
requires: Check TPO/register status before quoting; correct notice/application per route; diary the statutory response window per case

legislation.citation: Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998 (6-monthly for lifting persons); PUWER 1998 (training for work equipment incl. chainsaws)
legislation.failure_mode: Injury with lapsed inspection; insurer walks away
legislation.law: LOLER inspections + chainsaw competence (no statutory 'chainsaw licence' exists)
legislation.notes: NPTC tickets are an insurance/council-panel requirement, not statute. Never call it a licence.
requires: 6-monthly thorough examination for climbing kit used for lifting persons; documented chainsaw training (NPTC route) for insurance + council work

legislation.citation: Electricity at Work Regulations 1989; Building Regulations 2010 Part P; Electrical Safety Standards (PRS England) Regulations 2020
legislation.failure_mode: Injury liability; invalidated insurance; PRS prohibition on letting
legislation.law: Electrical competence + Part P + PRS 5-yearly EICRs
requires: Competent persons only; notifiable domestic work via registered scheme or building control; private rentals need valid 5-year EICR

legislation.citation: Veterinary Medicines Regulations 2013; Misuse of Drugs Regulations 2001; RCVS Practice Standards Scheme
legislation.failure_mode: Failed unannounced RCVS inspection; dispensing prosecution
legislation.law: VMR batch/prescriber/5yr retention + Schedule 2 CD register + PSS
requires: Every dispense: batch + prescriber logged, 5yr retention; CD running balances with witnesses; PSS evidence pack always ready

legislation.citation: UK GDPR + Data Protection Act 2018; PCI DSS (contractual via acquirers)
legislation.failure_mode: ICO fines; card-scheme withdrawal; breach-notification duties
legislation.law: Data protection + card-data handling
requires: Lawful basis + minimisation for client data/photos; never store raw PANs; secrets as refs

legislation.citation: Road Traffic Act 1988 s.143 (hire & reward); TfL TPH licensing; AMAP rates (verified via gig research: 55p/mile to 10k from Apr 2026)
legislation.failure_mode: Uninsured driving (criminal); deactivation; SA underclaim
legislation.law: Hire-and-reward insurance + PCO licensing + mileage rules
requires: Hire & reward cover (SDP excludes paid work); PCO licence for London private hire; log all miles for AMAP

legislation.citation: Animal Welfare Act 2006; Animal Welfare (Licensing of Activities Involving Animals) (England) Regulations 2018
legislation.failure_mode: Unlicensed boarding/daycare prosecution; incident without protocol
legislation.law: Boarding/daycare licensing + welfare duty
requires: Local-authority licence for boarding/daycare/breeding; 5-star rating criteria as ops checklist; incident protocol

legislation.citation: Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005; DVSA MOT standards; Food Safety and Hygiene (England) Regulations 2013
legislation.failure_mode: Prohibition notices; invalid MOTs; hygiene ratings collapse
legislation.law: Fire safety + MOT integrity + food hygiene baselines
requires: Fire risk assessment + competent persons (hotels/venues); honest MOT testing per DVSA standards; FHRS hygiene discipline

legislation.citation: Consumer Rights Act 2015; Consumer Contracts Regs 2013; HMRC £1,000 trading allowance
legislation.failure_mode: Chargebacks + returns spiral; trading past allowance unregistered
legislation.law: Consumer rights + distance selling + trading allowance
requires: Fit-for-purpose goods; 14-day distance returns info; register with HMRC past £1k trading income

legislation.citation: GMC Good Medical Practice; duty of candour (HSCA Reg 20); Access to records (DPA 2018)
legislation.failure_mode: Clinician decides wrongly on machine-triaged case; record fragmented
legislation.law: Clinical judgment stays with registered clinicians; duty of candour on harm
requires: Agent handles admin + navigation only; every clinical decision traceable to a registered clinician; open disclosure on harm

legislation.citation: COSHH Regulations 2002 (salon chemicals); industry patch-test duty of care
legislation.failure_mode: Reaction without patch-test record; HSE notice
legislation.law: Chemical safety + patch-test records in hair/beauty
requires: COSHH assessments for tints/bleach; patch test + record before colour services

legislation.citation: Platform ToS (contract, not statute) + NORTHSTAR hard-honesty §1
legislation.failure_mode: Banned accounts; lost handles; no legal recourse
legislation.law: Social account creation is human-only (PLATFORM RULE, not legislation)

legislation.failure_mode: Unauthorised spend
legislation.law: Money moves on human approval (DESIGN RULE, not legislation)

Risk assessment + controls for ladder/window work at height; competent persons only
